area1_metro.rationale: R1, R2, R3 all converge on Hanoi/HCMC mainstream 1.25-1.85M range. Median of 3 recommendations (1.5M, 1.5M, 1.7M) = 1.5M. R3's 1.7M was pulled up by including luxury outliers (Léman 2.7M, The Marq); trimming to mainstream yields 1.5M consensus.
citations: Vinhomes Metropolis / Goldmark City listings 1.75M VND/month (Hanoi)
Masteri Thao Dien 1.4M, Vinhomes Central Park 1.7M, Golden River 2.2M (HCMC)

area1_other.rationale: Median of R1=1.0M, R2=1.0M, R3=1.1M is 1.0M. Da Nang Monarchy luxury 1.4-1.6M anchors upper bound; Hai Phong SHP Plaza 1.0-1.5M and Can Tho tax-reference 1.2M support 1.0-1.2M; Hue tiered (300K/600K/150K per QĐ 30/2017) pulls average down. Compromise 1.0M represents typical apartment in this tier.
citations: Hue QĐ 30/2017 chung cư thu nhập thấp 300K, smart 600K, general 150K
Hai Phong The Minato Residences 1.6M VND/month

area2_provincial.rationale: TIEBREAKER REQUIRED: R1=0.8M, R2=1.0M, R3=0.8M. Divergence 25% exceeds 15% threshold. 2/3 vote (R1, R3) wins at 0.8M. R2's higher value (1.0M) reflects Vinhomes-branded provincial projects (Vinhomes Ocean Park Hưng Yên 1.25M, Ecopark 1.0M); these are atypical for 'typical provincial chung cư resident' which is what ViDrive's 4-tier model targets. Splitting into area2_vinhomes/area2_standard exceeds the 4-tier granularity. Pick 0.8M.
citations: Đồng Nai / Biên Hòa private apartment 600-700K VND/month
Bắc Ninh standard chung cư 600-900K VND/month
Long An / Tây Ninh standard 500-800K VND/month

area3_rural.rationale: All three researchers unanimous at 500K VND/month. Anchored by QĐ 05/2018 Quảng Trị cap (~600K), Tuyên Quang public 600K, OneHousing survey of huyện ngoại thành 400-800K.
citations: QĐ 05/2018 Quảng Trị rural public parking cap ~600K VND/month
Tuyên Quang public parking reference ~600K VND/month
OneHousing rural / huyện ngoại thành survey 400-800K VND/month

notes: The +100% area2 jump and +400% area3 jump are defensible. ViDrive's prior area2_provincial=400K was materially too low — even a rural quán cóc operator in Bình Dương or Bắc Ninh charges 500-700K for an apartment spot, and BĐS Đức Khải lists 800K-1.1M. Prior area3_rural=100K is implausible — at that price you could not even rent a basic motorcycle spot in a huyện-level town (QĐ 05/2018 Quảng Trị alone caps public parking at ~600K). The +400% jump reflects correcting a near-placeholder value, not a real price change. Conversely, area1_metro and area1_other were set too high (perhaps reflecting luxury-only data), and trimming them -25%/-33% brings the values into the mainstream-chung-cư band that applies to ~80% of users. Net direction: align ViDrive's parking assumptions with the realistic mainstream, not the luxury ceiling and not the rural floor.
